razonamiento: Merged visual whiteboard boxes with spoken descriptions for Deputy's deployment compliance architecture. 'VICE EAMS' represents Service Teams (UserCompanyDeveloper). NON-PROD and PROD represent internal company deployment and production environments (UserCompanyInternalPlatform). ECS hosts the Kong API Gateway, Lambda executes compliance checks across 25 functions, RDS PostgreSQL defines the compliance framework, DynamoDB records deployment events, and SNS handles alerts. SQS and downstream deployment tools mentioned in narration without visual representation or connection to the drawn components are omitted to keep the architecture faithful to the whiteboard. Edges combine drawn lines and spoken flows for pipeline event processing and deployment.
